variables.name: N_DES_WEAK_KEYS
variables.comment: * Table of weak and semi-weak keys taken from Schneier pp281

methods.name: public static boolean isWeakKey(byte[] key, int offset)
methods.comment:
* DES has 16 weak keys. This method will check * if the given DES key material is weak or semi-weak. * Key material that is too short is regarded as weak. *

* See "Applied * Cryptography" by Bruce Schneier for more information. * * @return true if the given DES key material is weak or semi-weak, * false otherwise.

methods.name: public static void setOddParity(byte[] bytes)
methods.comment:
* DES Keys use the LSB as the odd parity bit.  This can
     * be used to check for corrupt keys.
     *
     * @param bytes the byte array to set the parity on.

methodNames: public static boolean isWeakKey(byte[] key, int offset)
